🚑 Account Rescue: When Things Go Wrong · Lesson 5 of 6

Money Stuck: Monetisation Rejected, Payouts Frozen, Brands Who Ghost

7 min read · Updated November 2026 · Free · Written for Kenya
Share: WhatsApp X Facebook Telegram LinkedIn

Since 1 October 2026, a Kenyan YouTuber can earn every shilling on paper and still be paid nothing. Google freezes payouts until a verified KRA PIN is in AdSense, and the name has to match exactly.

Most creator money problems aren't bans. They're paperwork: a PIN letter nobody opened, a tax form ignored in the notifications, a name spelt differently on two forms, or a brand deal agreed on a voice note. All of them can be fixed, mostly from your phone.

5%
withheld from Kenyan creators' payouts by Meta since 1 January 2026, and by Google from September 2026 YouTube earnings (The Star; Techweez)

Where the money gets stuck, and the route out

ProblemWhere to fix itThe rule to know
YouTube monetisation rejectedYouTube Studio > Earn; appeal with a short videoAppeal within 21 days. Or reapply 30 days after a first rejection, 90 days after later ones.
YouTube Partner Program suspendedAppeal from StudioAppeal within 21 days of suspension. Decisions usually come within 14 days.
AdSense address PINAdSense for YouTube > verify addressThe letter takes 3–4 weeks. Request a new one after 3 weeks. Unverified after 4 months means your channel is demonetised.
KRA PIN on YouTubeAdSense for YouTube > Payments > Payments info > Manage settings > Kenya tax info11 characters, capital letters, no hyphens. The name must match your Google payments profile.
Meta (Facebook / Instagram)Payouts and tax settings in Professional Dashboard or Meta Business Suite5% withheld at source. Wrong name, TIN or address can delay your tax certificates.
TikTokInbox > System notifications > 'Complete the Kenya tax form'Creator Rewards isn't available in Kenya yet. File the form so future payouts aren't held up.
A brand that won't payWritten demand, then the Small Claims CourtClaims up to KES 1 million, no lawyer needed, and cases should end within 60 days.
An EndaViral paymentTicket with order ID and M-Pesa codeOne ticket can list several orders.
💡 The mismatch that freezes payouts

Google says the documents you submit for Kenya tax info must match your existing payments profile exactly. If AdSense says 'Wanjiru M. Kamau' and your KRA PIN is under 'Mary Wanjiru Kamau', fix the mismatch before you submit, not after the payout fails.

Payout on hold? Check in this order

  1. Identity verification. AdSense gives 45 days from the first request to submit documents.
  2. Address PIN. Entered within 4 months? Three wrong entries also cause problems, so request a new PIN rather than guessing.
  3. Tax info. KRA PIN on Google, tax details on Meta, the Kenya tax form on TikTok.
  4. Payment method. Bank details correct, and the account name matches.
  5. Threshold and timing. AdSense pays between the 21st and 26th of the month once your balance passes your payment threshold. Smaller balances roll over.
✗ MYTH

A monetisation rejection means YouTube has blacklisted my channel.

✓ REALITY

A rejection means reviewers think a significant part of the channel doesn't meet policy. The email names the policies. You can appeal within 21 days, or fix the content and reapply after 30 days (90 after later rejections).

When a brand ghosts you

Move it from WhatsApp vibes to a paper trail. Chase politely twice, then send a written demand giving 14–21 days. If that's ignored, the Small Claims Court takes claims up to KES 1 million. Filing fees start at KES 200 for claims under KES 200,000, and you can represent yourself. Bring the chat, the posted content, M-Pesa statements and proof the demand was delivered.

📋 Three-step brand payment chaser
DAY 1 (friendly): Hi [Name], hope the campaign went well! The [Reel/TikTok] went live on [date] (link: [ ]). Sharing the invoice again for KES [amount], due [date]. M-Pesa Till/Paybill: [ ]. Thanks!

DAY 7 (firm): Hi [Name], following up on invoice [no.] for KES [amount], which was due on [date]. Please confirm the date payment will be made.

DAY 14 (final): Dear [Name], payment of KES [amount] for [deliverables] delivered on [date] remains outstanding despite reminders on [dates]. Please pay within 14 days of this message. If I don't receive it, I'll file a claim at the Small Claims Court without further notice. Regards, [Full name, KRA PIN]
✅ Do this today
⚡ Quick check

Your AdSense address PIN letter still hasn't arrived after three weeks. What happens if you just keep waiting?

YouTube's help page says to request a replacement PIN after 3 weeks, and that an address still unverified after 4 months leads to demonetisation. Some locations can verify online if AdSense offers it.

🧠 Key takeaways
  1. Most stuck money is paperwork: PIN, tax form, matching names, payment method.
  2. Since October 2026, Google freezes Kenyan payouts without a verified KRA PIN.
  3. A rejected YouTube application has routes back: appeal within 21 days, or reapply after 30 or 90 days.
  4. Chase brands in writing. The Small Claims Court handles up to KES 1 million without a lawyer.
